entries.signature: void cblas_sscal(int N, float alpha, float *X, int incX)
entries.notes: X *= alpha. BLAS level 1. Replaces x *= scalar. In-place NEON SIMD.

entries.name: cblas_saxpy
entries.signature: void cblas_saxpy(int N, float alpha, const float *X, int incX, float *Y, int incY)
entries.notes: Y += alpha*X. BLAS level 1. Replaces y += alpha * x vectorized add. NEON SIMD.

entries.notes: In-place real FFT. Replaces np.fft.rfft. Split-complex format. Radix-2.

entries.name: vDSP_sve
entries.signature: void vDSP_sve(const float *__A, vDSP_Stride __IA, float *__C, vDSP_Length __N)
entries.notes: Sum of vector elements. *C = Σ A[i]. Replaces np.sum. NEON SIMD with pairwise reduction.

entries.name: cblas_snrm2
entries.signature: float cblas_snrm2(int N, const float *X, int incX)
entries.notes: Euclidean norm. BLAS level 1. Replaces np.linalg.norm. NEON SIMD.

entries.name: cblas_sgemm
entries.signature: void cblas_sgemm(CBLAS_ORDER, CBLAS_TRANSPOSE, CBLAS_TRANSPOSE, int M, int N, int K, float alpha, const float *A, int lda, const float *B, int ldb, float beta, float *C, int ldc)
entries.notes: Single-precision GEMM. C = alpha*A*B + beta*C. Replaces np.matmul (float32). Uses AMX on M-series.

entries.name: sgesv_
entries.signature: void sgesv_(int *n, int *nrhs, float *a, int *lda, int *ipiv, float *b, int *ldb, int *info)
entries.notes: Solve AX=B via LU. Replaces np.linalg.solve (float32). LAPACK driver routine.

entries.name: vDSP_vadd
entries.signature: void vDSP_vadd(const float *__A, vDSP_Stride __IA, const float *__B, vDSP_Stride __IB, float *__C, vDSP_Stride __IC, vDSP_Length __N)
entries.notes: C[i] = A[i] + B[i]. Vectorized element-wise add. Replaces np.add. NEON SIMD.

entries.name: vDSP_vmul
entries.signature: void vDSP_vmul(const float *__A, vDSP_Stride __IA, const float *__B, vDSP_Stride __IB, float *__C, vDSP_Stride __IC, vDSP_Length __N)
entries.notes: C[i] = A[i] * B[i]. Vectorized element-wise multiply. Replaces np.multiply. NEON SIMD.

entries.signature: void spotrf_(char *uplo, int *n, float *a, int *lda, int *info)
entries.notes: Cholesky factorization A=LL^T. Replaces scipy.linalg.cholesky. LAPACK computational routine.

protocols.recipe:
import ctypes, numpy as np
_acc = ctypes.CDLL('/System/Library/Frameworks/Accelerate.framework/Accelerate')

def cblas_sgemm_multiply(A, B):
    # A: float32 (M,K), B: float32 (K,N) → C: float32 (M,N)
    # C = 1.0 * A @ B + 0.0 * C
    M, K = A.shape
    N = B.shape[1]
    C = np.zeros((M, N), dtype=np.float32)
    A = np.ascontiguousarray(A, dtype=np.float32)
    B = np.ascontiguousarray(B, dtype=np.float32)
    _acc.cblas_sgemm.restype = None
    # CblasRowMajor=101, CblasNoTrans=111
    _acc.cblas_sgemm(
        ctypes.c_int(101), ctypes.c_int(111), ctypes.c_int(111),
        ctypes.c_int(M), ctypes.c_int(N), ctypes.c_int(K),
        ctypes.c_float(1.0),
        A.ctypes.data_as(ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_float)), ctypes.c_int(K),
        B.ctypes.data_as(ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_float)), ctypes.c_int(N),
        ctypes.c_float(0.0),
        C.ctypes.data_as(ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_float)), ctypes.c_int(N))
    return C
